        o.observstation AS site_name,
        t.telescregistry AS telescope_id,

        AS numeric), 4) AS aoi,
        -- LIF = (1 - lunardistdeg/180) * (1 - atmostransparency)
        ROUND(CAST(
            (1 - o.lunardistdeg/180.0) * (1 - o.atmostransparency)
        AS numeric), 4) AS lif,
        -- PointAccArc from telescopes
        t.pointaccarc AS point_acc_arc,
        -- Equipment problem flags
        CASE WHEN t.equipstatus != 'Operational' THEN 'EquipmentNotOperational' ELSE NULL END AS equip_issue,
        CASE WHEN t.calibrstatus != 'Current' THEN 'CalibrationNotCurrent' ELSE NULL END AS calib_issue,
        CASE WHEN t.coolsysstatus != 'Normal' THEN 'CoolingNotNormal' ELSE NULL END AS cool_issue
    FROM observatories o
    JOIN telescopes t ON o.observstation = t.observstation
    JOIN signals s ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
),
with_oqf AS (
    SELECT *,
        -- OQF = AOI * (1 - LIF) * (PointAccArc < 2 ? 1 : 2/PointAccArc)
        ROUND(CAST(
            aoi * (1 - lif) * (CASE WHEN point_acc_arc < 2 THEN 1 ELSE 2.0/point_acc_arc END)
        AS numeric), 4) AS oqf
    FROM base
),
site_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        site_name,
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT telescope_id, ', ' ORDER BY telescope_id) AS telescope_ids,
        ROUND(CAST(AVG(oqf) AS numeric), 4) AS avg_quality_score,
        -- Equipment problems combined
        COALESCE(STRING_AGG(DISTINCT equip_issue, ', ' ORDER BY equip_issue), '') || 
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(STRING_AGG(DISTINCT equip_issue, ', ' ORDER BY equip_issue), '') != '' AND 
                  COALESCE(STRING_AGG(DISTINCT calib_issue, ', ' ORDER BY calib_issue), '') != '' 
             THEN ', ' ELSE '' END ||
        COALESCE(STRING_AGG(DISTINCT calib_issue, ', ' ORDER BY calib_issue), '') ||
        CASE WHEN (COALESCE(STRING_AGG(DISTINCT equip_issue, ', ' ORDER BY equip_issue), '') || 
                   CASE WHEN COALESCE(STRING_AGG(DISTINCT equip_issue, ', ' ORDER BY equip_issue), '') != '' AND 
                             COALESCE(STRING_AGG(DISTINCT calib_issue, ', ' ORDER BY calib_issue), '') != '' 
                        THEN ', ' ELSE '' END ||
                   COALESCE(STRING_AGG(DISTINCT calib_issue, ', ' ORDER BY calib_issue), '')) != '' AND
                  COALESCE(STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cool_issue, ', ' ORDER BY cool_issue), '') != ''
             THEN ', ' ELSE '' END ||
        COALESCE(STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cool_issue, ', ' ORDER BY cool_issue), '') AS equipment_problems,
        -- Count of issues (count non-null issues)
        COUNT(CASE WHEN equip_issue IS NOT NULL OR calib_issue IS NOT NULL OR cool_issue IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS issue_count,
        -- For confidence level: use average AOI
        ROUND(CAST(AVG(aoi) AS numeric), 4) AS avg_aoi,
        -- Check if any equipment is not operational
        MAX(CASE WHEN equip_issue IS NOT NULL OR calib_issue IS NOT NULL OR cool_issue IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_equipment_issues
    FROM with_oqf
    GROUP BY site_name
)
SELECT 
    site_name,
    telescope_ids,
    avg_quality_score,
    equipment_problems,
    issue_count,
    CASE 
        WHEN avg_aoi > 0.8 AND has_equipment_issues = 0 THEN 'High'
        WHEN avg_aoi >= 0.5 AND avg_aoi <= 0.8 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS confidence_level
FROM site_agg
ORDER BY avg_quality_score DESC;
